nodes.title: Creative Arts: Visual Arts
nodes.description: Visual Arts for Grade 7 covering two-dimensional and three-dimensional art, art history and appreciation, and visual literacy through the four streams: Drawing, Painting, Printmaking, and three-dimensional art.

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Term 1: 2D and 3D art focusing on pattern, texture and form; introduction to South African art and artists.

nodes.title: Drawing and Pattern — Elements of Art
nodes.description: Elements of art: line, shape, form, colour, texture, value, space; principles of design: pattern, repetition, contrast; observational drawing from life; contour drawing; drawing natural forms and patterns found in South African flora and fauna. Art history: introduction to San rock art — symbols, patterns and storytelling. Practical task: detailed observational drawing using patterns from nature.

nodes.title: Painting — Colour Theory and Expression
nodes.description: Colour theory: colour wheel, primary/secondary/tertiary colours, warm/cool colours, complementary colours; colour mixing; painting techniques: washes, blending, dry brush; expressive use of colour. South African artists: Gerard Sekoto, George Pemba — social realism and colour. Practical task: expressive painting exploring colour relationships.

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Term 2: Printmaking and 3D construction; African art traditions and craft.

nodes.title: Printmaking — Relief Printing
nodes.description: Introduction to printmaking: relief printing processes; linocut, foam plate or polystyrene printing; positive/negative space; creating a printing plate; inking and printing; multi-colour printing; repetition and pattern in prints. African textile patterns and Ndebele geometric design as inspiration. Practical task: relief print incorporating African pattern motifs.

nodes.title: 3D Art — Construction and Assemblage
nodes.description: Three-dimensional art: form, volume, space, texture in 3D; construction methods using cardboard, wire, clay or found objects; assemblage and collage; African sculpture and craft — Zulu beadwork, pottery, weaving. Visual literacy: analysing 3D artworks from different cultures. Practical task: 3D construction or assemblage inspired by African craft traditions.

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Term 3: Mixed media and typography; global and contemporary art.

nodes.title: Mixed Media and Collage
nodes.description: Mixed media art: combining drawing, painting, collage, printmaking; found materials and textures; photomontage; layering and composition; identity and self-portrait through mixed media. Art history: Romare Bearden — African-American collage art; David Koloane — South African collage. Practical task: mixed media self-portrait or identity artwork.

nodes.title: Visual Communication and Typography
nodes.description: Visual communication: posters, logos, branding; typography: letterforms, font selection, layout; composition and visual hierarchy; colour in graphic design; analysing advertisements and visual media. Global artists: commercial and graphic designers. Practical task: poster or logo design for a school event or community campaign.

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Term 4: Environmental art and sculpture; portfolio review and art appreciation.

nodes.title: Environmental and Land Art
nodes.description: Environmental art: art made from or in nature; land art and sculpture using natural materials; environmental themes in contemporary art; recycled and upcycled art; art as social commentary on environmental issues. Andy Goldsworthy — land art; South African environmental artists. Practical task: small-scale environmental art using natural or recycled materials.

nodes.title: Portfolio Review and Art Appreciation
nodes.description: Compiling and presenting a portfolio of work from the year; artist statement writing; self-evaluation and peer critique; art gallery visit or virtual tour; consolidating visual arts vocabulary and critical analysis skills; celebration of creative work.
